about: The client's movie player, held by ecl::GameControl at +0x190: a playlist name, a queue of video names played one after another, the current name, the engine's video player (ls::VideoManager) at +0x38 and the skip flags. code:ecl::GameControl::ShowMovie fills it, code:ecl::VideoManager::NextVideo plays from it.

evidence.says: Osi.MoviePlay in a test level: +0x24 written 0->1 by the queue push in code:ecl::GameControl::ShowMovie and 1->0 by code:ecl::VideoManager::NextVideo; +0x30 written to the played name by code:ecl::VideoManager::NextVideo and back to none when the clip ended
code:ecl::VideoManager::NextVideo decrements +0x24 as it pops the queue at +0x18 and copies the popped name into +0x30 before looking its file up

Osi.MoviePlay in a test level: +0x24 written 0->1 by the queue push in code:ecl::GameControl::ShowMovie and 1->0 by code:ecl::VideoManager::NextVideo; +0x30 written to the played name by code:ecl::VideoManager::NextVideo and back to none when the clip ended
code:ecl::VideoManager::NextVideo decrements +0x24 as it pops the queue at +0x18 and copies the popped name into +0x30 before looking its file up
the macOS build's ecl::VideoManager methods (NextVideo, Skip, OnInputEvent, OnVideoStarted) and bg3_dx11.exe's code:ecl::VideoManager::NextVideo use these offsets
